name: Redtooth Keep
description: An Eldraine keep whose elves were cursed to become werefoxes at night.

description_citations.text: "Werewolf". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A witch curses the elves of Redtooth Keep for denying hospitality to travelers, making them werefoxes at night.
timeline.quote: elves of Redtooth Keep were cursed by a witch for denying hospitality to a group of travelers

citation.text: "Werewolf", section "Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, Syr Armont investigates and breaks the curse.
timeline.quote: Syr Armont traveled to Readtooth Keep to investigate and eventually broke the curse
